mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium as investors anticipate future rate hikes, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: Over a 12-month period, 20-day forward returns during inflation spikes are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 0.3% in at least 40% of months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly rise in PAYEMS labor cost index (>2% YoY) coinciding with a decline in UNRATE unemployment suggests labor market tightening, which elevates equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >2% YoY AND UNRATE decreases in the same month
failure_condition: Across 5 consecutive quarters where the trigger occurs, the 60-day forward return mean is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the correlation between PAYEMS/UNRATE movement and SPX 60d return is <0.2.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in GDPC1 personal consumption expenditures exceeding 2% YoY, accompanied by a rise in HOUST retail sales, signals robust consumer demand that supports higher corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases by >2% YoY AND HOUST increases in the same month
failure_condition: In 20 instances of this signal, the 5-day forward return is not positive (median < 0) or the cross-correlation between (GDPC1-HOUST) change and SPX 5d return is <0.1.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in INDPRO manufacturing index below 50 (indicating contraction) coincides with a sharp drop in RSAFS retail sales, creating supply-side weakness that depresses risk appetite and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 50 AND RSAFS decreases in the same month
failure_condition: During 10 such contraction events, the 20-day forward return mean is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the predictive power (IC) of the signal is <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged period of FEDFUNDS below 1% (three consecutive months) reduces the real discount rate applied to equities, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days in a non-recessionary regime.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% for three consecutive months and GDP growth > 2% in the preceding quarter
failure_condition: Across 8 such episodes, the 60-day forward return mean is not statistically positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the IC is <0.1.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 5.5% in a single month signals labor market weakness that increases uncertainty and reduces equity risk appetite, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.5% in the current month
failure_condition: In 15 such episodes, the 20-day forward return mean is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the predictive power is <0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A one-time monthly spike in PAYEMS labor cost index exceeding 3% without a corresponding rise in GDPC1 consumption suggests wage-driven inflationary pressure that prompts a short-lived equity sell-off, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >3% YoY AND GDPC1 remains flat in the same month
failure_condition: During 8 such events, the 5-day forward return mean is not significantly negative (median > 0) or the cross-correlation between (PAYEMS-GDPC1) change and SPX 5d return is >0.15.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in both INDPRO (manufacturing) and HOUST (retail) by at least 2% each, without a recovery in the following month, indicates persistent supply-side softness that depresses market sentiment and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by >=2% AND HOUST decreases by >=2% in the same month AND both remain below baseline in the following month
failure_condition: Across 6 such double-contraction episodes, the 60-day forward return mean is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or predictive IC <0.08.
